geometry_attempts.explicit_first: Yes: native v1–v10 renderings preceded/falsified successive changes. Bodies, marks, domains, mesh, phases and shared gaps were drawn. R6 field ideas were reused rather than declaring Paddle boxes to be true rows.
geometry_attempts.right: This is substantially closer to the charter methodology than a box-only patch. Pixel-obstacle rendering replaced an overbroad rectangle-overlap veto after visualization falsified it. It recorded uncertainty and did not promote a failed candidate.
geometry_attempts.wrong: The slow model was not reliable enough: rule endpoints manufactured horizontal region cuts (4959 p1), finite table rules did not constrain right-hand rows (8314 p20), a whole-region unresolved_columns guard substituted for layout, endpoint normal-run tests could shrink already found weak text (31f40), and _assign retired an entire parent when only some content transferred. Mean-ridge photometry was compared to A’s different reference statistic. Whole-component audits missed partial characters. Running all this after much of the legacy stack was not a cheap rendering of the same model.
geometry_attempts.fast_vs_slow: Independent recount:207 active pages,11,447 native paths and11,422 reduced;75 pages differ in count,199 native paths unmatched. The deliberately slow obstacle loop and scatter reductions give identical emitted items on207/207, but share region/phase/assignment logic. This validates the obstacle implementation, not the slow page model’s truth.
geometry_attempts.check_assessment: T2_check’s retirement, endpoint, unsafe region cut, unresolved-column and table-barrier findings agree with the report, source snapshot and V1. Their precise failure is incomplete ownership and incorrect physical domains. It is incorrect to explain all T2 failures as excessive zero-loss vetoing: the destructive retirement had no complete coverage check.
geometry_attempts.methodological_grade: B for shared physical-row construction; C/D for the unvalidated endpoint/retirement/region-veto policies. Obstacle scatter parity alone could merit A as a narrow primitive, never for the entire candidate.

geometry_attempts.right: Typed NormalInk reused A’s reference; grouped median replaced mean-ridge contrast; physical rule paths/white gaps replaced rule-end slabs; finite table barriers and intersecting components improved the physical observation. Retention itself need not preserve a wrong partition—ink can be reassigned losslessly. These implementations’ box floors/leftovers constrain reassignment; that is not an inherent conflict between no text loss and physical modeling.
